glsa.title: libinput: Multiple Vulnerabilities
glsa.synopsis: Multiple vulnerabilities have been found in libinput, the worst of which could result in privilege escalation.

background.p: A library to handle input devices in Wayland and, via xf86-input-libinput, in X.org.

description.p: Multiple vulnerabilities have been discovered in libinput. Please review the CVE identifiers referenced below for details.

impact.p: Please review the referenced CVE identifiers for details.

workaround.p: There is no known workaround at this time.

resolution.p: All libinput users should upgrade to the latest version:
